text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected in gpu-pool-us-east-1 — multiple containers restarting during prefill. severity: high. symptoms: repeated OOMs during long-context prefill, exit code 137. paging oncall. ticket: INC-4321
ana-oncall: I'm on call — looking now, grabbing recent node/container logs. tagging infra and runtime.
josh-dev: seeing repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in runtime logs around prefill stage. long prompts (~80-120k token windows) seem to spike KV allocations. sample log: ```E [runtime] CUDA error: out of memory at prefill.cpp:243` process=server pid=8123```
opsteam: nodes show containers restarting loop: kube reports `OOMKilled` and node kernel dmesg shows oom-killer targeting `server` PID. affected nodes: gpu-02,gpu-03,gpu-07.
sara-cs: FYI this is impacting a handful of paid customers on hosted-prod; roughly 4-6% 5xx on /v1/generate over last 12m. support has one inbound from Acme about degraded latency.
ben-cs: sending a quick customer note: "we're investigating a memory issue causing restarts; temporary mitigation in progress" :thumbsup:
josh-dev: proposing immediate mitigations (short term): 1) enable prefill token cap for the route `large-context` to 2048 tokens 2) enable KV cache aggressive trimming (`kvcache_trim=1`) 3) fallback routing of very large sessions to lower-memory model variant (model-lite) 4) apply restart backoff to avoid thrash. commands to toggle routing: ```curl -X POST https://platform.internal/routing/override -d '{"route":"large-context","max_prefill":2048}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'```
nana-oncall: doing (1) and (2) now. applying routing cap and kvcache trim. will coordinate node isolation if restarts continue.
opsteam: I cordoned gpu-03 and set it to drain frequency low to avoid immediate eviction. rerouted new requests off gpu-02/gpu-03 while we trim caches.
josh-dev: added a temporary in-runtime guard to short-circuit prefill when input tokens > 25k and replace with streaming fallback to avoid huge KV allocations. patch deployed to canary (1 pod)
sara-cs: monitoring, error rate dropped to ~1.1% after cap + kvcache trim. some restarts persisted on gpu-07 but not new ones. customers updated with short note.
ben-cs: customers asking for ETA — replying that we're monitoring and will provide update in 30m.
nana-oncall: moving to ops bridge if restarts continue on gpu-07. opening an ops call now and will escalate to infra if node kernel panics show up.
josh-dev: follow-up: we'll run a post-incident job to analyze long-request distribution and recommend model-quantization or prefix caching for top offending routes. logging this in INC-4321.
opsteam: for now metrics look stable; final check in 20m then we'll uncordon gpu-03 and re-balance. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
